counterbalance: Six assisted-first and six manual-first cases, same case and source cards in each pair.
timing: Real monotonic wall-clock elapsed from material exposure to recorded response. Includes model and tool/orchestration overhead; does not isolate human active work. No sleep or fabricated duration.
source_cards: Relevant source cards preselected by frozen expected document IDs for both conditions; this removes realistic manual search and is an oracle evidence-selection aid.
assisted: Review/edit an existing cached automatic or oracle-corrected draft; if unavailable, compose a manual fallback. No new LLM requests.
limits: Same coordinator performs both conditions; no blinding, carryover and memory effects.
Twelve synthetic tasks are a convenience sample, not a real customer or human-participant study.
Measured phase times exclude earlier generation and staff-intent-override waiting time; cannot imply full handling-time savings.
Small model/tool timing differences are noisy and do not prove a causal productivity effect.
Earlier incomplete in-memory timing observations are not included or reconstructed.
